messages:
Ava (docs): quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to fix confusing wording on the Dedicated provisioning page. The page currently uses the word `eviction` in a few spots but the runtime config uses `preemption`. Users are tripping over this in onboarding. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4582 :eyes:

Ethan (eng-runtime): confirmed — internal config key is `preemption` and behavior differs slightly from naive \"eviction\" wording. We prefer `preemption` for accuracy. Suggest docs show both briefly: 'preemption (formerly referred to as eviction)' and mention the drain window and fallback semantics.

Priya (eng-sre): +1. Also we should clarify SLA implications: if a request is routed to a fallback model because of preemption, that should not be counted as an SLA breach unless the fallback returns an error. Add a bullet under SLA exceptions.

Luis (eng-platform): for the docs snippet, propose adding this YAML example under provisioning examples so customers can see the flag and a recommended policy: ```yaml
dedicated_pool:
  name: tenant-a-pool
  gpu: a100-80gb
  preemption: soft  # options: none | soft | strict
  preemption_drain_seconds: 30
  fallback_model: rwd-medium-v2
```

Sam (devex): I'll add a short Python SDK sample too. Draft: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.create_dedicated_pool(
    name="tenant-a-pool",
    gpu="a100-80gb",
    preemption="soft",
    preemption_drain_seconds=30,
    fallback_model="rwd-medium-v2"
)
print(resp.id)
```

Ethan (eng-runtime): tiny nit — the SDK method is `provision_dedicated_capacity` in the current SDK. Also call out that `preemption: soft` means we attempt to move in-flight work to fallback; `strict` will immediately free resources and may drop requests.

Ava (docs): good catch, Ethan. I'll update the snippet and add a 1-paragraph migration note for anyone who used the old `eviction` wording in customer-facing templates. Also adding the SLA bullet per Priya.

Priya (eng-sre): can we add an example SLO line? e.g., \"SLA exception: preemption-triggered fallback does not count against uptime if fallback succeeded within Xs\" — we can finalize wording in the PR.

Luis (eng-platform): another small add — link to the autoscale policy docs where we describe burst/scale-down interplay with preemption. I'll attach the link in the PR comment.

Ava (docs): done, PR updated with YAML + corrected Python snippet + migration note + SLA bullet. Asking for one more quick review from eng-runtime (Ethan) and devex (Sam) before merge.

Ethan (eng-runtime): thumbs up from me, wording is accurate. :thumbsup:

Sam (devex): tested the sample locally with the staging SDK; adjusted method name and looks good. I'll add a tiny test harness to the snippets folder.

deploy-bot: PR #4582 merged to main by Ava — CI green :tada:

Ava (docs): thanks team! I'll follow up with a tiny CHANGELOG entry and a note in the migration-guide doc. Leaving a TODO to add a small interactive example in the console later. :wave:
